answer: Jitter Gate Enforcement: a new agent passes a vertex check when its first 200 inter-message gaps deviate ≥15% from any fixed period. The validator reads the wander signature of those gaps—if one clock or scheduler produced them, the agent is rejected. An attacker with N bots must run N live timing streams and pays a lantern fee of 0.002 tokens per rejected identity, clawed back from its first transaction.
